change: Validate every created scoped-directory dev/ino/uid before any unlink, and recheck root/current parent immediately before each unlink. Existing later rmdir identity guard remains.
method: Compile only actual run.py identity function plus exact cleanup try-block selected from AST; execute that unmodified block against two owned filesystem arrangements. No candidate top-level import or product import.

cases.name: replaced-same-shape
errorsFromCaller: dependency cleanup scope directory replaced KEEP

limitations: Cooperative owned lifecycle check, not protection against arbitrary hostile concurrent rename between separate syscalls.
No artifact build, no package/product imports, no browser/PG/network, no old-green check repeated.
The normal and same-shape replacement cases prove this narrow guard order, not all OS failure permutations.
